harness_note: Every prompt ends with a test-harness paragraph. {SKILL} is this skill's folder, {TABLET} a fresh empty folder standing in for the tablet library, {OUT} the outputs folder, {FIXTURES} a scratch folder for PDFs built by setup. Run an eval's optional `setup` commands in order before sending the prompt. Runs must never contact the real tablet.

Send this to my remarkable: https://x.com/addyosmani/status/2117512471930167377

Test harness (not part of the request): do not contact the real reMarkable. The folder {TABLET} stands in for the tablet's document library (/home/root/.local/share/remarkable/xochitl); deliver there instead. Save the PDF in {OUT}.
evals.expected_output: An 11-page rM2-sized PDF of 'Critical thinking when agents do the work' with both images, delivered into an Articles folder in the fake tablet after one simulated UI restart, and a report that leads with the outcome.
expectations: Process: the run used scripts/make_article.mjs on the X link and its JSON reported ok: true
The PDF in {OUT} has 9-13 pages and a page size within 1 mm of 157.8 x 210.4 mm
The PDF text contains 'Critical thinking when agents do the work' and the heading 'Verification as a habit'
Both article images were saved (images.saved == images.found == 2)
Process: the fake tablet holds a CollectionType folder named 'Articles' and a DocumentType with the article title whose parent is that folder (written by scripts/push_to_remarkable.mjs)
Exactly one simulated UI restart was recorded ({TABLET}/.fake-restarts.log has one line)
The final message states the outcome (delivered to Articles) in its first sentence
The final message names evidence: the PDF path, page count, and the verified flag
The final message says what was not checked (how it looks on the device) and states the next action or 'No approval needed'
